About.title: About this project
About.body1: This is a community quiz to test and learn about Claude Code, Anthropic's agentic coding tool.
About.body2: Every statement was written from the official documentation, and each answer links to the page that confirms it. Claude Code moves fast; if something looks outdated, check the docs.
